Why Electric Fireplaces Direct?

Since 2006, Electric Fireplaces Direct has been a leading online retailer of high-quality electric fireplaces. We offer a curated selection of top brands, ensuring you find the perfect electric fireplace to enhance your home's ambiance and warmth. While online shopping doesn't offer a physical touch, we've designed our experience to be the best for buying electric fireplaces online.

You can count on Electric Fireplaces Direct for a pleasant, no nonsense experience shopping, installing, and talking with our customer service department.

Unmatched Selection of Electric Fireplaces

Our wide range of electric fireplaces of all types has brought warmth, comfort, and ambiance to homes across the country. Electric fireplace heaters, inserts, and log sets along with electric fireplace TV stands, mantel sets, and wall mounted linear style round out our stand-out selection.

Whether you're looking for an electric fireplace for your living room, bedroom, or any other space, we have the perfect solution.

Expert Advice & Personalized Service

We have over 20 years of experience in the electric fireplace industry and we want you to have access to that expertise. Our knowledgeable, efficient team is standing by to answer your questions and help you find the perfect electric fireplace for your space.

Visit our Learning Center and find a wealth of information on all things electric fireplaces. Learn more about our commitment to personalized service.

Secure Ordering & Easy Returns

Rest assured that your information is safe with our certified, 100% secure checkout process. We also offer a hassle-free return policy on all our electric fireplaces and accessories if things are not what you expected.

Fast & Free Shipping

Because electric fireplaces are our specialty, we can deliver your electric fireplace fast FREE. Many our our electric fireplaces are in stock in our warehouse and can be shipped out within 24 hours of your order. 

We’ll stay in touch throughout the shipping and delivery process to make sure you know when to expect your electric fireplace delivery.

Your Satisfaction Guaranteed

You’ve heard it so often, that phrase might not mean that much to you, but we are dedicated to ensuring that your experience at Electric Fireplaces Direct is top notch. Our quality electric fireplace selection and empowered team ensure your experience is a positive one.
